messages.subject: PLACEMENT NOTICE: Halcyon Devices hiring Embedded Engineers
messages.body:
Dear Students,

Halcyon Devices will be conducting a campus drive for the Embedded Engineer position (CTC 10.5 LPA).
Eligibility criteria: Branches - CSE, ECE, EEE. CGPA requirement - 7 and above. Candidates must have zero active backlogs.
Interested and eligible students should fill the form at https://forms.gle/halcyonEE latest by 11:59 PM on 21 September 2026.

Thanks,
Career Office
